preconditions.description: The input linked list must not be empty.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(node, ListNode) for node in linked_list_nodes)
preconditions.description: All nodes in the linked list must be instances of ListNode.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= node.value <= 10**6 for node in linked_list_nodes)
preconditions.description: The value of each node in the linked list must be between 1 and 10^6.

postconditions.description: The returned root must be a valid binary search tree.
The preorder traversal of the BST must match the expected output.
The BST must contain all unique values from the linked list.

invariants.expression: all(node.left.value < node.value < node.right.value for node in bst_nodes)
invariants.description: For every node in the BST, the left child's value must be less than the node's value, and the right child's value must be greater.

invariants.expression: all(node.left is None or node.right is None for node in bst_nodes if node.left is not None and node.right is not None)
invariants.description: The BST must maintain the property of being balanced.
